title: Southeast Fraud Enforcement Partnerships
question: What did DOJ actually publish about the 17-case roll-up, State data-sharing agreements and three announced task forces?
bluf: DOJ announced a mixed-status 17-case roll-up, high-level access agreements for specified State-held public records and three task forces. The public record did not establish executed terms, actual data use, case-level causation, pre-payment intervention or recovered aggregate funds; the headline amount was intended loss.
